test_title: PYST 50: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Pipe P can fill (5)/(9) part of a tank in 25 hours, and pipe Q can fill (3)/(7) part of the same tank in 27 hours. Both P and Q were kept open for 3 hours, then both were closed. Pipe R alone was then opened and it emptied the water in the tank in 4 hours. Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in:
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe P fills 5/9 part of tank in 25 hours

⇒ Time taken by P to fill full tank = 25 × (9 ÷ 5) = 45 hours

Pipe Q fills 3/7 part of tank in 27 hours

⇒ Time taken by Q to fill full tank = 27 × (7 ÷ 3) = 63 hours

P and Q are opened for 3 hours

Pipe R empties the tank in 4 hours

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM of 45 and 63 = 315 units

⇒ Total capacity of tank = 315 units

⇒ Efficiency of P = 315 ÷ 45 = 7 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 315 ÷ 63 = 5 units/hr

⇒ Work done by P and Q together in 1 hour = 7 + 5 = 12 units

⇒ Work done by P and Q in 3 hours = 12 × 3 = 36 units

⇒ Pipe R empties 36 units in 4 hours

⇒ Efficiency of R = 36 ÷ 4 = 9 units/hr

⇒ Net combined rate of P, Q and R = 7 + 5 − 9 = 3 units/hr

⇒ Time taken to fill the tank together = 315 ÷ 3 = 105 hours

**∴ Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in 105 hours.**
